title: silicon-ledger-enginemon facet + capture-record schema, version 1
description: Instrument schema for enginemon v2 (tools/enginemon): the unprivileged per-engine IOReport sampler whose calibration is the subject of EXP-024. Two consumers: (1) as an OpenClaims facet, the required keys are _producer and _schemaURL and the fields below describe what a capture pointer attaches to a claim; (2) the JSONL capture stream itself (the 's' records) is described under x_stream_record, so any consumer can validate a raw file without reading the C source. Producer naming, declared honestly: the cross-repo contract pins _producer to a bare repository name. enginemon is an instrument INSIDE silicon-ledger, not a repo; this facet therefore uses the compound name 'silicon-ledger-enginemon' rather than the bare 'silicon-ledger', so the instrument stream and the ledger's claim facet can never collide on a merge. The deviation from the literal rule is deliberate and is the only way to keep facet keys one-per-instrument, which is the contract's actual purpose. Reachability, declared honestly: the private repo returns 404 for this URL by design (owner decision, see CROSS-REPO-CONTRACT.md 'Launch state'); the public mirror host 4rg0naut/silicon-ledger-public serves this same path (schemas/ is in the publish allowlist); no local consumer depends on URL resolution. Field set DISJOINT from both companion facets (silicon-ledger: kind/topic/entities/caveat/split/legacy_confidence/evidence_status; silicon-ledger-bench: suite/report/fingerprint/window/validation/band): a merged ledger stays filterable by facet key alone.

_producer.description: Compound instrument name (repo-instrument); see the schema description for why the bare-repo-name rule is deliberately bent for an in-repo instrument.

_schemaURL.description: Pinned raw URL of this file. Private repo: 404 by design until publication; public mirror: resolves. Declared, not asserted.

capture.description: Repo- or HUB-relative path of the JSONL capture this claim points at. The capture is the evidence; the facet pins the pointer.

window.description: Contamination label, same spirit as the bench facet's window. 'in-session' = an agentic session (oMLX resident, GPU-active) shared the machine; the 2026-10-05 M5 Max calibration windows are ALL in-session by construction and must be read with their idle-baseline deltas, not as absolute floors.

tool_version.description: enginemon version string emitted in the hdr record (e.g. '2.0'); counter naming migrations are driver-version-dependent, so a capture without its tool version is a pointer without a referent.

hw_model.description: hw.model from the hdr record (e.g. 'Mac17,14'). Cross-machine join guard, same role as the bench fingerprint: M4 channel names and M5 channel names differ structurally (AMC 'ANE DCS RD' vs per-client 'PRIM GFX DCS RD'; interrupt subgroup 'ane 0' vs 'ane0 0'/'dart-ane0 0'); an M4 number must never be compared to an M5 number on channel name alone.

os_build.description: kern.osversion from the hdr record (e.g. '26A434'); the IOReport surface changes with OS updates (EXP-022 captured 26A428; this calibration ran on 26A434 with a changed AMC surface).

privilege.description: Which IOReport surface the capture sees. Measured 2026-10-05: at user level the M5 Max subscription omits the AMC Stats group entirely and CPU/ANE0 energy deltas are frozen at zero; the GPU rail (Energy Model 'GPU Energy') and the GPU tensor-unit groups (GPU UT Engagement / GPU UT AggD Stats) are live at user level. A zero from a user capture is only meaningful for channels proven live at user level.

engines_covered.description: Engines the capture's calibration matrix certifies for cross-arm attribution. An engine with no CALIBRATED positive signal may not appear here even if channels carry its tag.

x_stream_record.description: Schema for one 't':'s' line of a JSONL capture. The full stream is: one hdr record (identity, matches the facet keys above), N sample records, one 't':'sum' aggregate.

dt.description: Seconds since the previous sample; rates are computed as delta/dt, never from wall-clock assumptions.

n.description: Channel name as published by the driver (never renamed by the tool).

u.description: Driver unit label (mJ, nJ, 24Mticks, events, or empty).

e.description: Engine tag: which engine this channel evidences. A TAG, not a verdict; calibration (see facet engines_covered) decides.

d.description: Delta accumulated over this interval (IOReportCreateSamplesDelta; state/histogram channels summed across states). VERSION NOTE: v2.0 captures (exp024 r1-r3, exp022) emitted the since-start CUMULATIVE total in this field despite this description — divide successive values or use the sum record's energy_mw; from v2.1 the field is per-interval as documented. State entries ('s') follow the same version rule for 'r'.

s.description: Per-state/per-bucket residency for state and histogram channels (e.g. the UT engagement centi-% buckets); absent otherwise.
